metadata.article_title: No part rejected, if it can be reasonably construed.

article.title: No part rejected, if it can be reasonably construed.
article.content:
85No part rejected, if it can be reasonably construed.

Section 85  ·  Part VI · Chapter VI  ·  page 34 of the Act
No part of a will shall be rejected as destitute of meaning if it is possible to put a reasonable construction upon it.
